subject: load nvimcom for different R environments

messages.author: 673abe0191f101be
messages.subject: load nvimcom for different R environments
parts:
Hi,
I'm using nvim-r with neovim and tmux on a cluster where we load different R versions via
module files into the current environment.
Is it possible to start the automatic installation for every environment or how should this be done?
Any suggestions?

Thanks

messages.author: b256a2742aacd200
messages.subject: Re: load nvimcom for different R environments
parts:
You can install nvimcom manually with the following commands:

cd /path/to/Nvim-R/R
R CMD build nvimcom
R CMD INSTALL nvimcom_0.9-25.tar.gz

To install nvimcom for different R versions, you have to run the last command with each R version.
